description: Antigravity provider with native Gemini 3.7 Flash, Claude, and GPT-OSS support
Legacy Antigravity OAuth provider (retained for Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite support)
Pi Voice STT Extension with Termux TTS. See docs/pi-voice-stt-setup.md for hardware button routing.

postInstallInstructions: Set defaultBackground to false in ~/.pi/workflows/settings.json so omitted workflow calls run inline.

Customize the installed package so its workflow tool resolves omitted background as params.background ?? loadWorkflowSettings({ cwd }).defaultBackground ?? false; preserve explicit background: true as the opt-in for detached delivery.
